data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word αλητης (helps), Aleta means 'noble, helper'. In Christianity, this name is associated with the virtues of kindness, faith, and loyalty. The name Aleta carries the meaning “Noble, Helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aleta usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
